The correct response is not to appeal, not to find a workaround, and not to use a friend's account in another country. The correct response is to build infrastructure that does not depend on their permission to operate. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront. NOWPayments verifies payments on-chain and fires a webhook the moment a transaction confirms. Your backend processes the order and delivers the product automatically. No platform involved at any step.

content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Online gumroad

Gumroad, Stripe, and PayPal provide a range of services for selling digital products, but they come with limitations. Stripe operates in only 46 countries, leaving many potential creators without options. Gumroad and PayPal are also prone to sudden account suspensions, which can freeze your funds for extended periods. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure allows creators to build and host their own stores, maintaining full control over their products, payments, and customer data. By using platforms like Cloudflare and NOWPayments, you gain a truly independent solution that is not subject to the same restrictions.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal have stringent geographic restrictions, making them unavailable in numerous countries. This exclusion effectively sidelines entire markets of digital creators who seek to sell their products online. Gumroad also shares this restriction, limiting access for those who need it most. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, however, operates without these geographic limits, allowing creators in Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan to launch their online stores without the fear of being locked out. With the right tools, anyone can access global markets without relying on traditional platforms.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment processing speed varies greatly between platforms. With Stripe, transactions can take days to settle, and high fees eat into profits. PayPal's fee structure can be complex, with potential for additional costs if your account is suspended, which can leave you with frozen assets for up to 180 days. In contrast, using NOWPayments with sovereign infrastructure results in low fees (0.5%) and instant payment confirmations on-chain, allowing you to retain more of your earnings and access your money immediately. This efficiency can substantially enhance your revenue and cash flow.
Ownership means no more dependency on restricted platforms.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

True ownership of your digital store and products is a significant differentiator. With platforms like Gumroad or Stripe, you are effectively renting access, with their terms dictating your operations. Sovereign commerce infrastructure guarantees that once deployed, you own your store and all associated data. Automation tools facilitate seamless product delivery and payment processing, ensuring customers receive their purchases instantly without your manual intervention. This empowers creators to focus on building their products rather than managing transactions.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture depends on your specific needs. If you're looking for a straightforward approach with limited products, the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) may suffice. However, if you're preparing to scale with more products and advanced integrations, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is ideal. This comprehensive setup includes tools like Cloudflare Pages and Supabase, ensuring a robust, scalable solution that can grow with your business. Evaluate your product range and expected customer volume to make the best choice.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Instant payment processing keeps your cash flow healthy.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
